descriptor: Field Notes blog on craft, writing and tools

voice.summary: Sounds like a studio that sketches on paper before touching a screen: observant, a little dry, fond of slow methods. Essays are personal and specific, never listicles.
dos: Name the object or place in the first line
Prefer the concrete detail to the abstract claim
Let a short sentence land after a long one
donts: No claiming a rule where there is only a habit

taglines: Slow notes from a small studio
A blog for people who sketch
boilerplate: Corvid & Co is a small design studio whose Field Notes blog collects essays on drawing, writing, tools and process, all written slowly and kept on warm paper.
